```{r cars}
library(readxl)
df = read.csv("House Prices.csv")
head(df)
```

Beberapa variabel numerik memiliki nilai NA seperti : LotFrontage, MasVnrArea,GarageYrBlt
```{r}
numericVariabel = c('LotFrontage','MasVnrArea','GarageYrBlt','TotalBsmtSF', 'GarageCars', 'GarageArea', 'BsmtFinSF1' ,'BsmtFinSF2', 'BsmtUnfSF',  'MasVnrArea')
library(ggplot2)

for (i in numericVariabel) {
 histogram = ggplot(df, aes_string(x = i)) +
             geom_histogram()
 print(histogram)
}


```
Dari histogram, data tidak berdistribus normal dan terdapat outlier sehingga NA dapat diisi dengan median
```{r}
# Imputasi dengan median
df$LotFrontage[is.na(df$LotFrontage)] <- median(df$LotFrontage, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GarageYrBlt[is.na(df$GarageYrBlt)] <- median(df$GarageYrBlt, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GarageCars[is.na(df$GarageCars)]   <- median(df$GarageCars, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GarageArea[is.na(df$GarageArea)]   <- median(df$GarageArea, na.rm = TRUE)
df$TotalBsmtSF[is.na(df$TotalBsmtSF)] <- median(df$TotalBsmtSF, na.rm = TRUE)
df$BsmtFinSF1[is.na(df$BsmtFinSF1)]   <- median(df$BsmtFinSF1, na.rm = TRUE)
df$BsmtFinSF2[is.na(df$BsmtFinSF2)]   <- median(df$BsmtFinSF2, na.rm = TRUE)
df$BsmtUnfSF[is.na(df$BsmtUnfSF)]     <- median(df$BsmtUnfSF, na.rm = TRUE)
df$MasVnrArea[is.na(df$MasVnrArea)] <- median(df$MasVnrArea, na.rm = TRUE)



var_numerik_lengkap = c('LotFrontage',
'LotArea',
'OverallQual',
'OverallCond',
'YearBuilt',
'YearRemodAdd',
'MasVnrArea',
'BsmtFinSF1',
'BsmtFinSF2',
'BsmtUnfSF',
'TotalBsmtSF',
'X1stFlrSF',
'X2ndFlrSF',
'GrLivArea',
'FullBath',
'HalfBath',
'BedroomAbvGr',
'KitchenAbvGr',
'TotRmsAbvGrd',
'Fireplaces',
'GarageYrBlt',
'GarageCars',
'GarageArea',
'WoodDeckSF',
'OpenPorchSF',
'EnclosedPorch',
'X3SsnPorch',
'ScreenPorch',
'PoolArea',
'MiscVal',
'MoSold',
'YrSold')

# korelasi Spearman semua variabel numerik terhadap SalePrice
cor_hasil <- sapply(var_numerik_lengkap, function(v) {
  cor(df[[v]], df$SalePrice, method = "spearman")
})

# Urutkan dari terbesar ke terkecil (nilai absolut)
cor_hasil <- sort(cor_hasil, decreasing = TRUE)

# Tampilkan hasilnya
cor_df <- data.frame(
  Variabel   = names(cor_hasil),
  Korelasi   = round(cor_hasil, 3),
  Kekuatan   = ifelse(abs(cor_hasil) >= 0.5, "Kuat",
               ifelse(abs(cor_hasil) >= 0.3, "Sedang", "Lemah"))
)
print(cor_df)
```
Cek MLR dari variabel numerik yang Korelasi Spearman terhadap SalePrice kuat 
```{r}
#semua variabel yang korelasi dengan saleprice nya kuat
house_numeric_mlr = lm(SalePrice~
OverallQual +
YearBuilt +
YearRemodAdd +
TotalBsmtSF +
X1stFlrSF +
GrLivArea + 
FullBath + 
TotRmsAbvGrd +
Fireplaces +
GarageYrBlt +
GarageCars +
GarageArea, 
data = house)

summary(house_numeric_mlr)

#kurangi 1 variabel GarageYrBlt yang p-valuenya tertinggi
house_numeric_mlr = lm(SalePrice~
OverallQual +
YearBuilt +
YearRemodAdd +
TotalBsmtSF +
X1stFlrSF +
GrLivArea + 
FullBath + 
TotRmsAbvGrd +
Fireplaces +
GarageCars +
GarageArea, 
data = house)

summary(house_numeric_mlr)

#kurangi 1 variabel TotRmsAbvGrd yang p-valuenya tertinggi
house_numeric_mlr = lm(SalePrice~
OverallQual +
YearBuilt +
YearRemodAdd +
TotalBsmtSF +
X1stFlrSF +
GrLivArea + 
FullBath + 
Fireplaces +
GarageCars +
GarageArea, 
data = house)

summary(house_numeric_mlr)

# uji multikolinearitas dengan VIF
library(car)
vif(house_numeric_mlr)

#Garage cars ada multikolinearitas tinggi, maka eliminasi
house_numeric_mlr = lm(SalePrice~
OverallQual +
YearBuilt +
YearRemodAdd +
TotalBsmtSF +
X1stFlrSF +
GrLivArea + 
FullBath + 
Fireplaces +
GarageArea, 
data = house)

summary(house_numeric_mlr)

# cek lagi dengan vif
vif(house_numeric_mlr)
```
